mapper.insert: INSERT INTO bookings (user_id, movie_id, screening_id) VALUES (#{userId}, #{movieId}, #{screeningId})
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bookings b JOIN screenings s ON b.screening_id = s.screening_id WHERE b.user_id = #{userId} AND b.booking_status = 'DONE' AND (s.screening_date + s.start_time) > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
